title: Finding Words Associated with DIF: Predicting Differential Item Functioning using LLMs and Explainable AI

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) between female and male students from test item text using a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and extracting word-level associations using SHAP token attributions.

Predicting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) between White students and various focal groups (Asian, Black, Hispanic, and Native American students) from test item text using a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and identifying influential words using SHAP.

Predicting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) between lower socioeconomic status (LSES) and non-LSES students from test item text using a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and identifying influential words using SHAP.

Predicting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) between students with disabilities (SWD) and non-SWD students from test item text using a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and identifying influential words using SHAP.
Predicting Differential Item Functioning (DIF) between English learners (EL) and non-EL students from test item text using a fine-tuned DeBERTa model and identifying influential words using SHAP.
